## Definition of Ready

- [ ] Goal is clear.
- [ ] Scope is bounded.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are explicit.
- [ ] Related docs are linked.
- [ ] Affected layers are known.
- [ ] No blocking open question remains.
- [ ] Out-of-scope work is explicit when the task is likely to expand.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] Acceptance criteria are satisfied.
- [ ] Changes are committed or ready for review.
- [ ] Relevant checks, builds, tests, or manual verification were run, or the reason for not running them is stated.
- [ ] Docs are updated if behavior, architecture, scope, workflow, or project memory changed.
- [ ] `project-log.md` is updated if this is a meaningful milestone.
- [ ] `OPEN_QUESTIONS.md` is updated if new unresolved questions appeared.
- [ ] ADR is added or updated if an important architecture or workflow decision was made.
